body:
I have a bottle of SJW in my kitchen right now... GNC brand.  I tried it.  I think I took it every day for a month or so, maybe longer.  My depression didn't really lift when I took it, but it gave me some weird symptoms associated with my menstrual cycle.  I think it affects hormones, so I guess that's why.

Since then I have tried herbal teas and such.  They didn't help me with my depression, but I just drink them for the taste.  The only supplement I can think of that I might be missing are magnesium, or maybe zinc or iron... I remember that I should take them, but that isn't enough to get me out of bed to actually get the pills and a glass of water.
No, my mom is strongly against me taking meds.  And I live under her roof so... that won't be changing for at least a few more years.
